title: The Window Seat and One More Hip
youtube_title: The Window Seat and One More Hip | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smaller piece, fairly given, can still be enough.
summary: At a bakery counter on a soft, busy morning, Tamsin sees that a window seat with room for one more hip will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Tamsin makes a smaller, even share so Lior is included, and Ms. Okonkwo lets the choice stand without a speech.
